app.name: Kindred
app.tagline: Two agents. Two ways to meet someone.

home.greeting: Tonight, how do you want to meet someone?
home.placeholder: Say it in your own words — who you'd like to meet, or what you'd love to do with someone…
home.placeholder_locked: Set up your profile first — the Agent needs to know you before it can introduce anyone.
home.agents_footnote: Two agents working in the background

gate.title: The Agents need to know you first.
gate.body: Kindred shows people the words you write — not labels we infer. Take five minutes to set up your profile, then come back.

home.profile_nudge: So the Agents can introduce you too —

matchmaker.name: Matchmaker
matchmaker.desc: Tell the agent what kind of person makes a room feel different for you. It introduces one person at a time, with a reason.

sidebyside.name: Side by Side
sidebyside.tagline: Meet over something you both already do.
sidebyside.desc: Tell the agent what you do — tennis, runs, climbing, a bookstore Saturday. Once a week, it proposes one real meet. Both have to say yes; either says no and the other never knows.

chat.placeholder_first: Tell me about who you're looking for…
chat.placeholder_followup: Reply, or tell me what to change
chat.disclaimer: Mock profiles. Nothing leaves your browser.

intro.empty_hint: Not a list — one person at a time, with a reason. Tell me what you're looking for on the left.
intro.after_hello_hint: When they write back, I'll flag it in the corner. You can keep meeting others.

moment.pick_one: Pick the one that landed for you
moment.reply_placeholder: Not a compliment, not a question — what you thought when you read this, or your own version of it.
moment.reply_hint: They'll see only this and the one you picked. Not your name yet, not your photo. If they don't reply, they never know you saw them.
moment.need_user_moments: Heads up: your profile is thin. If they say hello back, they won't have anything of yours to read. Edit your profile to add a Moment or two.
moment.anchor_label: What you've already seen of each other
moment.compose_hint: Which one do you want to reply to? Tap one — optional.
moment.reply_placeholder_open: The first thing you want to say to them…

connection.title: Connections
connection.hello_hint: They'll see what you wrote and the part of theirs you read. Not your name yet — that only unlocks if they reply.
connection.empty: No one yet. Say hello to someone from the Matchmaker and they'll show up here.
connection.pick_one: Pick a conversation on the left.

incoming.label: Someone read you
incoming.pick_to_reply: Pick one of {{name}}'s moments to reply to — optional
incoming.hint: If you don't feel it, just close this. They won't be told.

gate.title: Let them see you, not keywords.
gate.body: What others read is written in your own words. Fill in a little or a lot — it saves as you type.
gate.return_hint: Changes save as you type — hit the back arrow whenever you're ready.

hello.faded_hint: This didn't land last time. It's OK to move on — or say something new.

meet.label: Proposed meet
meet.title: A real meet — if you both want it.
meet.subtitle: You see name and photo only after they accept too. Either passes, the other never knows.
meet.form_subtitle: I look for someone whose real weekly rhythm overlaps with yours.
meet.watching_hint: I'll propose at most one meet a week, and only when it's a real fit. No proposal today — I'll come back.
meet.composer_placeholder: Tell me to look again, or to adjust your activity
meet.confirmed_note: On the day, you'll see each other's name & photo at the venue. Nothing more, nothing less. Just go play.

understanding.title: What I've learned about you
understanding.empty: Tell me a bit about who you're looking for, and I'll keep track here.

profile.subhead: This is exactly how others see you. Write it in your own words — short, specific, true. The Agents read this, they never invent it.

section.vitals_hint: Facts the system uses to decide who's near you. Anyone you're introduced to sees these.
section.compat_hint: Soft signals the system uses to put more likely fits higher. All optional.
section.moments: Pick at least {{n}} and answer in your own words
section.moments_hint: Other people read this to decide whether to say hello. Specific beats clever.
section.one_work: One thing you've cared about lately
section.one_work_hint: A book, film, album, exhibition, meal — any form. One line on why it stuck.

weekend.q: An unclaimed weekend — you're most yourself when you…

conflict.q: When something rubs you the wrong way with someone close, you tend to…

five_years.q: The next few years, what you most want is…
five_years.depth_one_thing: To go deep on one thing

activities.title: Things you actually do
activities.hint: Weekly rhythms, not aspirations. Side by Side uses these to find real overlaps.

mbti.title: MBTI (optional)
mbti.note: Shown as a tag on your profile. Not used for matching.

profile.done_note: Looks good. Anything you change here is reflected immediately in how others see you.
profile.incomplete_note: Whatever you've filled is saved — come back anytime to add more.
profile.autosave_hint: Saves as you type. Stop anytime, pick up later.
profile.preview_hint: This is exactly what someone the Matchmaker introduces will see on the right pane.
